preservation_rules: Do not remove BTCUSD from M7C.
Do not refit M7C for BTC ML V1 or GOLD M10 research.
Do not reset the M7C prospective start, runtime, formula, matching rules or review gates.
Keep collector, M7C and M8C running unchanged unless a separately diagnosed incident is explicitly reviewed.

m10_scope.rule: Do not broaden M10 candidate, threshold, payoff or portfolio research to BTCUSD unless the user explicitly opens a new M10 BTC scope.

separation_rules: Track A and Track B are both legitimate BTC-related research but they answer different questions.
M7C BTC observations do not automatically become BTC4/BTC5/BTC6/BTC7R/BTC9R features, filters, entries or outcomes.
BTC ML V1 results do not modify M7C source matching, formulas, starts, gates or runtime.
M7C BTC observations do not automatically enter GOLD M10 candidate discovery, threshold design or portfolio research.
Do not merge feature/mochipoyo-alert-research into the BTC FF01 working branch merely to access M7C.
A future cross-track comparison requires a separate preregistered stage and explicit user authorization.
